```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
```

```{r}
breast_cancer <- read_csv("2019 breast cancer both genders.csv")
```

```{r}
unique(breast_cancer[, c("location_name", "location_id", "fips")])
```
```{r}
names(breast_cancer)
```


```{r}
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
breast_cancer <- breast_cancer %>%
  mutate(State = ifelse(
    str_detect(location_name, " County \\("),
    str_extract(location_name, "(?<=\\().*(?=\\))"),
    location_name
  ))

```

```{r}
head(breast_cancer[, c("location_name", "State")], 10)
```

filter(breast_cancer, State == "Alabama")
